scientific_scope_status: For a strongly connected loopless digraph G with adjacency B, N>=2 and spectral radius r>0, replace each vertex by the transitive tournament T_m and each original arc by all cross-block arcs. The source derives rho(B tensor J_m + I_N tensor T_m)=1/((1+1/r)^(1/m)-1), preservation of directed girth and delta-plus(G[T_m])=m delta-plus(G). For D_m=C4[T_m], rho(D_5)>20/3 although girth=4, and rho(D_m)/(4m)->1/(4 log 2)>1/3. These graphs have minimum outdegree density 1/4: they refute the proposed spectral implication, not Caccetta–Häggkvist. The substitution construction is acknowledged prior mathematics; originality of the calculation is unestablished.
